name: qol-project
description: Project-level conventions for the qol-tools ecosystem: the qol-mission (non-negotiable user-facing promises), qol-tools (org layout, dependency model), qol-cicd (shared workflows), qol-arch-code (cross-platform code strategy pattern), qol-arch-cross-platform (symbol/import hygiene that prevents dead_code-on-other-platform under -D warnings), qol-arch-cicd (CI/release workflow contract that enforces matrix builds and path-dep parity), qol-shared-libs, qol-plugin-template. Ships three PreToolUse hooks (one per arch skill) that block edits violating each contract.
